WITH inventory AS (
  SELECT *, CASE
    WHEN recognition->>'state' = 'recognized' THEN 'Recognized product identity'
    WHEN source_accounting->>'state' = 'reported' THEN 'Source identified; advisory mapping unknown'
    ELSE 'Unknown: source identity fields missing'
  END AS identity_status
  FROM evidence_pipeline.current_native_inventory_accounting
)
SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference, identity_status,
       source_accounting->>'installation_evidence' AS installation_evidence,
       count(*) AS observations
FROM inventory
GROUP BY origin, connection_id, scope_reference, identity_status,
         source_accounting->>'installation_evidence'
ORDER BY origin, connection_id, identity_status, installation_evidence

SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference, product_name, publisher,
       CASE WHEN facts->'manifest'->>'state' = 'read'
         THEN facts->'manifest'->>'display_name'
       END AS reported_display_name,
       facts->'manifest'->>'state' AS manifest_evidence,
       version AS reported_version,
       CASE
         WHEN recognition->>'state' = 'recognized' THEN 'Recognized product identity'
         WHEN source_accounting->>'state' = 'reported' THEN 'Source identified; advisory mapping unknown'
         ELSE 'Unknown: source identity fields missing'
       END AS identity_status,
       source_accounting->>'installation_evidence' AS installation_evidence,
       source_accounting->>'component_kind' AS reported_component_kind,
       source_accounting->'missing_fields' AS missing_identity_fields,
       recognition->>'state' AS product_recognition,
       recognition->>'family' AS recognized_family,
       recognition->>'reason' AS recognition_reason,
       recognition->>'applicability' AS inventory_only_applicability,
       facts->'is_bundle' AS reported_bundle,
       finished_at AS inventory_collected_at, receipt_id, device_receipt_id
FROM evidence_pipeline.current_native_inventory_accounting
ORDER BY origin, connection_id, product_name, receipt_id

SELECT i.origin, i.connection_id, i.scope_reference, i.product_name,
       i.version AS reported_version,
       i.facts->'manifest'->>'state' AS manifest_evidence,
       i.facts->'manifest'->>'reason' AS manifest_reason,
       CASE WHEN c.check_id IS NULL THEN 'Not checked for this inventory snapshot'
         ELSE 'Checked; overall applicability unknown'
       END AS component_check,
       COALESCE(c.metadata->>'defender_coverage', 'unverified') AS defender_coverage,
       c.result->>'reason' AS applicability_reason,
       c.result->'evaluations' AS per_cve_results,
       c.metadata->>'observed_at' AS component_observed_at,
       i.finished_at AS inventory_collected_at,
       c.metadata->'sources' AS source_references,
       c.check_id, i.collection_attempt_id AS inventory_snapshot, i.receipt_id
FROM evidence_pipeline.current_windows_inventory i
LEFT JOIN evidence_pipeline.current_component_assessments c ON c.receipt_id=i.receipt_id
ORDER BY i.origin, i.connection_id, i.product_name, i.receipt_id

SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference, product_name, version AS reported_version,
       result->>'state' AS overall_applicability,
       result->>'reason' AS applicability_reason,
       result->'evaluations' AS per_cve_results,
       metadata->>'defender_coverage' AS defender_coverage,
       metadata->>'observed_at' AS component_observed_at,
       finished_at AS inventory_collected_at, stored_at AS assessment_stored_at,
       check_id, inventory_attempt_id AS inventory_snapshot, receipt_id
FROM evidence_pipeline.component_assessment_history
ORDER BY stored_at DESC, check_id, receipt_id
LIMIT 200

SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference,
       result->'observed_identity'->>'name' AS component_name,
       result->>'version' AS observed_version,
       CASE WHEN result IS NULL THEN 'Requested components not observed'
         WHEN result->>'inventory_association' = 'exact_identity_and_version_only'
         THEN 'Identity and version match; observation times differ or are unverified'
         ELSE 'Inventory identity or version unverified'
       END AS inventory_association,
       not_observed AS components_not_observed,
       result->'manifest_evidence'->>'state' AS manifest_evidence,
       result->'manifest_evidence'->>'reason' AS manifest_reason,
       result->>'state' AS overall_applicability,
       result->>'reason' AS applicability_reason,
       result->'evaluations' AS per_cve_results, defender_coverage,
       component_observed_at, inventory_collected_at, stored_at,
       source_references, capture_sha256, check_id,
       inventory_attempt_id AS inventory_snapshot,
       result->>'inventory_receipt_id' AS inventory_receipt
FROM evidence_pipeline.selected_component_history
ORDER BY stored_at DESC, check_id, result->>'native_id'
LIMIT 200
